digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler snapshot persistence and differ
propositions: prev_snapshot.json is 228.1 MB / 4.5 MB per day (largest storage term); storing only jira_key set instead of full ACLI payload reduces HEAD from 27.1 MB to ~19 KB
218 of 399 consecutive snapshot pairs have identical key sets (become byte-identical with no commit); mean symmetric difference is 1.78 keys when sets change
Differ emits 973-998 unbound_local create mutations when prev contains keys not in curr; key-set shape eliminates these raw emissions at source

drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions call-site filter prevents all field-drift and unbound-local mutations reaching Jira; corpus diff over 4 real pairs showed zero observable mutation difference between full and key-set prev shapes

prev-shape-sensitive consumers (check_dual_identity_complete, differ local-only/emit-both arms) require mapping entries; dict {jira_key: {}} guard with local_state[key] or {} preserves behavior identically to full payloads
